term: shared root on populated accessible worlds
definition: SharedRootOnPopulated F present w root means that the fixed roster member root is present at every F-successor of w whose presence extension is inhabited. It makes no assertion that every successor is populated, that root explains or causes anything, or that the actual world w is accessible from itself. A root shared across histories is thus distinct from a necessarily present individual unless successor-relative population is established separately.
note: Independent mathematical diagnostic, not a reading attributed to Graham Oppy. Uses the already registered Kripke and rigid-roster semantics. See docs/necessary-individual-empty-world-fork.md.
